manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Lumbering Battlement, and Faceless Butcher must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Faceless Butcher for its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
